attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year at all. The whole of what it says of her is that she was the mother of Sava, whom it sends the reader to find on 14 Ιανουαρίου — the day the corpus's `sava-of-serbia` already carries on its Greek row — and that no other details of her life are known. She is none of the corpus's seven other Anastasias, all of whom are Roman, Serbian-unrelated or twentieth-century. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
